title: Nocturnal vertical gradients in O3, PAN and PAA in a boreal forest: the role of chemical reactions, deposition and entrainment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00159E, Paper

Simone T. Andersen, Carolina Nelson, Laura Wüst, Patrick Dewald, Gunther N. T. E. Türk, Jan Schuladen, Horst Fischer, Mikael Ehn, Tuukka Petäjä, Üllar Rannik, Ilona Ylivinkka, Lauri R. Ahonen, Robby Rynek, Helko Borsdorf, Thomas Mayer, Jos Lelieveld, John N. Crowley
Atmospheric stability is one of the main drivers of nocturnal gradients in O3, PAN, and PAA in forested environments. Entrainment from above the canopy leads to a reduction in the observed losses below the canopy.
